messages:
maria (CSM): Hi all — kicking off the Skylark onboarding. Sending a proposed set of success criteria and timeline. Can @liam and @sana confirm stakeholders and the SSO contact?
arjun (AE): Contract effective 2026-11-01. Dedicated capacity begins week of 2026-11-15. Renewal window earliest 2027-11 — low immediate risk but smooth ramp important.
liam (Skylark - IT): Confirming — I'm the infra lead and will own SSO + VPC peering. Adding Kate from security (kate.security@skylark.com) to the thread.
sana (Skylark - AI Lead): I'll be the product owner for inference. Priorities: chat latency reduction and embeddings for search relevance.
devon (Eng): Quick Qs: do you want Redwood Private (VPC/on‑prem) or Dedicated hosted for the initial pilot? Also need a sample dataset and expected traffic pattern (qps, token lengths).
olivia (PM): Proposed success metrics for the pilot: p99 < 300ms for chat generation, embedding throughput >= 50 req/s, baseline quality pass rate > 90% on eval set. Enablement plan: 2 technical workshops + 1 runbook handoff.
maria (CSM): Timeline draft: week 0 (prep) — access + SSO; week 1 — infra + network peering; week 2 — model onboarding + integration tests; week 3 — performance tuning + enablement sessions. Can folks confirm availability for a 1h kickoff next Wed?
liam (Skylark - IT): Wed works. Prefer 10–11 PT. I'll share the access request spreadsheet and SAML contact.
devon (Eng): For infra we'll need: service account, S3 read access to sample data, and SAML SP metadata. Small snippet of what speeds setup: 
```
- sp_entity: redwood-sp
- contact: liam@skylark.com
- attributes: email, name
```
olivia (PM): Also proposing a 10-prompt eval suite as a quality gate before model promotion. @sana can curate this?
sana (Skylark - AI Lead): Yes — I'll send the prompt set and expected outputs by EOD tomorrow.
maria (CSM): Flags/risk items: potential delays from legal on data residency and security approvals for peering. @arjun can you confirm whether Private deployment add-on is in scope?
arjun (AE): There's an option for Private with ~30 day lead time and an add-on fee. I'll verify the exact pricing and whether it's already included in the signed SOW.
onboarding-bot: Meeting scheduled: Skylark onboarding kickoff — Wed 2026-11-17 17:00 UTC (created by maria)
maria (CSM): Thanks — I'll post an agenda and a pre-req checklist in #customer-docs and send a calendar invite with prep tasks :rocket: 
liam (Skylark - IT): One more ask — we'd like log access for the first two weeks and a defined retention policy for traces.
maria (CSM): Noted; adding log retention and trace access to the enablement checklist.
devon (Eng): Tagging @olivia — where should we land the rollout plan doc?
olivia (PM): I'll create /runbooks/skylark-onboard and link it in the calendar invite after the meeting.
sana (Skylark - AI Lead): Great — excited to get started.
